name: androgen receptor

function.text: AR encodes androgen receptor. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in signal transduction and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Kennedy disease (x-linked); androgen insensitivity syndrome (x-linked).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Prostate adenocarcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

function.text: AR encodes androgen receptor. Steroid hormone receptors are ligand-activated transcription factors that regulate eukaryotic gene expression and affect cellular proliferation and differentiation in target tissues. Transcription factor activity is modulated by bound coactivator and corepressor proteins like ZBTB7A that recruits NCOR1 and NCOR2 to the androgen response elements/ARE on target genes, negatively regulating androgen receptor signaling and androgen-induced cell proliferation. Transcription activation is also down-regulated by NR0B2.

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Kennedy disease (x-linked); androgen insensitivity syndrome (x-linked).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving AR have been reported in prostate adenocarcinoma, prostate, and cholangiocarcinoma.
